title: Al-'Ibadah 'an Muhabbah: min al-'Adah ila al-Qalb (10-12 years)
description: A path to help parents guide their child from performing 'ibadah out of habit to loving it with the heart before puberty: Salah with love, the first fasts, a living relationship with the Qur'an, and du'a as intimate conversation.

primary_reference.info: تربية الأولاد في الإسلام لعبد الله ناصح علوان + منهج التربية النبوية للطفل لمحمد نور سويد

review_defects.arabic: العبادة عن محبّة: من العادة إلى القلب (10-12 سنة)
review_defects.english: Al-'Ibadah 'an Muhabbah: min al-'Adah ila al-Qalb (10-12 years)
review_defects.why: The Arabic title is transliterated instead of translated, so the meaning ('Worship out of Love: From Habit to the Heart') is lost to an English reader. The description does not compensate for the untranslated title.
